title: Your Life as a Samurai's Wife in Edo Japan
thumbnail_prompt: close-up of a young Japanese woman in an indigo Edo-period kimono with black hair in a marumage bun and tortoiseshell comb, eyes glistening with restrained emotion, warm lantern light on one side of her face, snowy samurai lane blurred behind
description:
You are married at twenty to a samurai you have met only once, in the snowy castle town of Kanazawa around 1820. Follow a whole life inside a modest samurai house: rice stipends, blackened teeth, winter pines tied like umbrellas, and a year alone while your husband marches to Edo with the lord.

A calm, unhurried second-person story to relax or fall asleep to, built on the everyday history of Edo-period Japan.
era_setting: Kanazawa castle town in Kaga domain, Japan, about 1820-1860: narrow lanes of tile-topped earthen walls, wooden samurai houses with tatami, shoji and verandas, indigo, brown and grey cotton and silk kimono, palette of indigo, straw gold, persimmon orange and snowy white.

characters.look: Japanese woman, early twenties at the start (grey-streaked later), slender, oval face, calm dark eyes, black hair in a glossy marumage bun with a tortoiseshell comb, muted indigo kimono with a dark brown obi
Japanese man, late twenties (grey later), lean build, clean-shaven, serious narrow face, shaved pate with a neat topknot, dark grey kimono and hakama, two swords at the left hip
Japanese woman in her sixties, small and slightly stooped, lined gentle face, grey hair in a plain low bun, plain brown kimono with a dark obi
Japanese boy about seven, round face, bright eyes, hair tied in a small tuft on top, short light-blue cotton kimono
Japanese girl of sixteen, sturdy build, round cheerful face, hair tied up in a white cloth, brown striped cotton kimono with a plain apron

scenes.narration: It is still dark when your mother lifts the white silk over your shoulders. Tomorrow you will belong to a house you have never entered.
scenes.image_prompt: a young bride standing still while an older woman drapes a white silk wedding kimono over her shoulders, lamplit room, paper screens, quiet anticipation, centred, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: You have met the man only once, across a formal room, with a go-between smiling politely at both families. His name is all you truly know.
scenes.image_prompt: a formal tatami room, a young woman kneeling across from a young samurai, an older go-between between them, low table with tea, soft daylight through shoji, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: This is Kanazawa, a snowy castle town on the Sea of Japan coast, around the year eighteen twenty. The great lord of Kaga rules here.
scenes.image_prompt: wide view of a snowy castle town at dawn, white castle walls and tiled roofs, river curving through, mountains beyond, pale pink sky, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Your father is a samurai of modest rank, and so is the groom. Neither family is rich. Their wealth is measured in rice, not coins.
scenes.image_prompt: a modest samurai house interior with straw rice bales stacked against a wall, wooden beams, warm afternoon light, calm domestic scene, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: A samurai is paid a yearly stipend in rice, counted in koku. One koku is roughly what one person eats in a year.
scenes.image_prompt: close view of rice being measured from a straw bale into a square wooden measuring box, hands of a woman in indigo sleeves, warm light, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Your husband's household receives about seventy koku. It sounds generous, but much of it must be sold to pay for everything else.
scenes.image_prompt: a rice broker's shopfront in a castle town street, bales being carried by porters, wooden signboard without writing, overcast morning, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: In the evening you travel by palanquin to his house in Nagamachi, the samurai quarter, where earthen walls line narrow, quiet lanes.
scenes.image_prompt: a lacquered palanquin carried along a narrow lane between tall earthen walls topped with tiles, lanterns glowing, dusk, gentle mood, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Inside, you and your husband sip sake three times each from three small cups. The ceremony is quiet. Nobody hurries you.
scenes.image_prompt: a young bride in white and a young samurai in formal black kneeling side by side, sipping from small red lacquer sake cups, candlelight, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: His mother watches from the side of the room, hands folded in her lap. From tonight, she will teach you how this house runs.
scenes.image_prompt: an elderly woman in brown kimono kneeling at the side of a candlelit room, hands folded, watchful but kind expression, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Later, alone, you hear the rain begin against the wooden shutters. The house smells of new tatami and cedar. You do not sleep for hours.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman lying awake on a futon in a dim room, rain streaking past a shuttered window, faint lantern glow, peaceful melancholy, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Your days begin before dawn. You kneel at the clay stove, coax the embers alive, and set the rice pot on to boil.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman kneeling at a clay kitchen stove at dawn, blowing gently on embers through a bamboo tube, steam rising, earthen floor, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Breakfast is simple: rice, miso soup with a little tofu or greens, and pickled daikon. Your husband eats first, then the rest of you.
scenes.image_prompt: a low wooden tray with a bowl of rice, miso soup and yellow pickles, a samurai kneeling to eat in morning light, calm, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: As a new wife, you have blackened your teeth with an iron and gall paste. In this age, it marks a married woman, and many find it beautiful.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman kneeling at a small lacquer mirror stand, preparing a small bowl of dark paste, soft morning light, dignified mood, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Your husband leaves for duty at the castle, two swords at his hip. Many days, his work is guarding a gate or copying records.
scenes.image_prompt: a samurai in grey hakama walking out through a wooden gate into a lane, two swords at his hip, morning mist, wife bowing at the gate, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: You sweep the rooms, air the bedding on the veranda, and sew. There is always a garment to mend, turn inside out, or unpick and remake.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman sewing an indigo garment on a veranda, futons airing on a rail beside her, small garden, dappled sunlight, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Your mother-in-law checks the household accounts beside you. Every coin for lamp oil, charcoal and fish is written down in careful brush strokes.
scenes.image_prompt: two women kneeling at a low desk with an account book and abacus, an older woman guiding a younger one, lamplight, calm concentration, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: You also manage the maid, a farm girl of sixteen named in whispers by the neighbours as the best cook in the lane.
scenes.image_prompt: a sturdy teenage maid in striped cotton kimono chopping vegetables in a kitchen, a young wife watching approvingly, warm light, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: In the afternoon you tend the small garden behind the house. Samurai families here often grow vegetables, persimmons, and a few flowers.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman tending vegetables in a small walled garden, a persimmon tree with orange fruit, late afternoon golden light, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Evenings are lit by a paper lantern burning rapeseed oil. The light is soft and orange, and it makes long shadows on the ceiling.
scenes.image_prompt: a quiet room at night lit by a single paper floor lantern, orange glow, long shadows on wooden ceiling, woman sewing beside it, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Before bed, you and your husband sometimes talk, very quietly, about small things. The rice price. A neighbour's cough. The shape of the clouds.
scenes.image_prompt: a young couple kneeling close together by a lantern, speaking softly, sliding doors half open to a dark garden, tender calm mood, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Slowly, the house stops feeling like his house. It begins, without anyone saying so, to feel like yours.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman kneeling on a veranda at dusk looking over a small garden with contentment, warm evening light, peaceful, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: In your second winter, you give birth to a son. The midwife tells you to sit upright for days, as custom demands. You obey, exhausted.
scenes.image_prompt: a young mother sitting upright on bedding holding a swaddled newborn, a midwife kneeling nearby, warm brazier glow, winter light, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Snow comes early in Kanazawa and piles heavily. Along Nagamachi, the earthen walls are wrapped in straw mats to protect them from the wet.
scenes.image_prompt: a snowy lane lined with earthen walls covered in woven straw mats, soft falling snow, grey sky, hushed and peaceful, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Inside, everyone gathers near the charcoal brazier. You warm your hands, then your son's tiny feet, then your hands again.
scenes.image_prompt: a young mother by a charcoal brazier warming a baby's feet in her hands, glowing embers, winter room, cosy mood, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: The pines in the gardens are tied with ropes from a central pole, like umbrellas, so that heavy snow cannot snap their branches.
scenes.image_prompt: a garden pine tree supported by ropes radiating from a tall central pole like an umbrella, fresh snow, soft white light, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Your son grows. At four, he chases the maid around the kitchen. At six, he sits at a low desk and learns his first characters.
scenes.image_prompt: a young boy with a small topknot kneeling at a low desk practising brush writing, his mother guiding his hand, soft daylight, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Samurai sons will study the Confucian classics and swordsmanship. You teach him patience first, because no one else seems to have time.
scenes.image_prompt: a mother and small son sitting together on a veranda watching snowfall, the boy holding a wooden practice sword, gentle mood, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: You were taught from a book of conduct for women, which said a wife should be gentle, obedient, and frugal. You are frugal. Mostly.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman reading a thin stitched book by lantern light with a faint smile, simple room, calm and wry mood, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: On New Year's morning you all eat ozoni, a soup with soft rice cakes. Your husband wears his best kimono, and your son is solemn with pride.
scenes.image_prompt: a family kneeling around a low table eating bowls of rice cake soup, pine decorations in the corner, bright winter morning light, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: In spring, you walk with your mother-in-law under the cherry blossoms. She points at the petals and says, very softly, that she once was you.
scenes.image_prompt: two women, one young and one elderly, walking beneath blossoming cherry trees along a riverbank, petals drifting, gentle spring light, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: She does not say more. But that night, she gives you her tortoiseshell comb, the one she wore on her own wedding day.
scenes.image_prompt: an elderly woman handing a tortoiseshell hair comb to a young woman in a lamplit room, both kneeling, tender moment, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Your son falls asleep against your arm. The snow melts off the eaves in a steady, soft dripping that lasts all night.
scenes.image_prompt: a young mother sitting in lamplight with a sleeping boy leaning against her arm, water dripping from eaves outside, peaceful night, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: You think this is what the rest of your life will be: snow, blossom, lamplight, and quiet. You are almost right.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman looking out through an open shoji at a moonlit garden, quiet contemplative expression, soft blue night light, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: One morning your husband comes home early, and sits too carefully. He has been chosen to travel with the lord's procession to Edo.
scenes.image_prompt: a samurai kneeling stiffly in a room while his wife pauses in the doorway holding a tray, morning light, tense quiet mood, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Under the shogun's system of alternate attendance, great lords must spend every other year in Edo. Their retainers go with them.
scenes.image_prompt: a long procession of samurai, porters and palanquins winding along a mountain road, banners without writing, early morning mist, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: The journey is more than four hundred kilometres. It takes around two weeks, over mountain passes and along the old coastal and inland roads.
scenes.image_prompt: a line of travellers crossing a high mountain pass with pine trees and distant peaks, late autumn colours, long winding road, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: He will be gone for a year. You fold his clothes, pack dried fish and a small pouch of coins, and say nothing that might make him worry.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman carefully folding clothes into a travel bundle, dried fish and a small pouch beside it, lamplight, restrained emotion, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: At the gate, he bows to his mother, touches your son's head, and looks at you a moment longer than custom allows.
scenes.image_prompt: a samurai in travelling clothes at a wooden gate, touching a small boy's head, his wife and elderly mother bowing behind, dawn light, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Now the house is yours to run. You collect the stipend rice, sell part of it to a broker, and haggle quietly and firmly.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman in indigo kimono speaking with a merchant at a rice broker's counter, bales behind, calm and determined expression, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: That year the domain announces it will borrow part of every retainer's stipend. Lords were deep in debt, and samurai families felt it.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman reading an official letter at a low desk, abacus beside her, thoughtful frown, grey daylight through paper screens, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: So you cut back. Less lamp oil. Cheaper fish. You take in sewing for a merchant's wife, which is common, even if nobody speaks of it.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman sewing by the last daylight at a window to save lamp oil, a pile of fabric beside her, quiet determination, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Letters from Edo arrive every few weeks, carried by the domain's couriers. You read each one twice, then once more to your mother-in-law.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman reading a folded letter aloud to an elderly woman beside a brazier, both kneeling, warm afternoon light, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: He writes of crowded streets, famous kabuki actors on printed pictures, and fires. Edo burns so often that people call fires its flowers.
scenes.image_prompt: a crowded Edo street with wooden shops and cloth shop curtains, people in kimono walking, distant smoke on the horizon, daytime, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: In late winter, your son catches a fever. For three nights you sit with him, cooling his forehead with a cloth dipped in cold water.
scenes.image_prompt: a mother kneeling beside a sleeping boy on a futon, holding a damp cloth to his forehead, single lantern, tender worried mood, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: On the fourth morning, he asks for rice porridge. You laugh, and then you cry, and then you go and make the porridge.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman stirring a pot of rice porridge at a clay stove at sunrise, relieved tearful smile, soft golden light, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: In spring, a runner brings word. The procession is coming home. You sweep the gate until the stones look almost new.
scenes.image_prompt: a young woman sweeping stone steps at a wooden gate in spring, cherry petals on the ground, bright morning, hopeful mood, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: He is thinner, and older around the eyes. He kneels before his mother, then turns to you and says only, you kept everything.
scenes.image_prompt: a travel-worn samurai kneeling before his wife in a sunlit room, both bowing slightly, deep quiet emotion, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: It is the most he will ever say about it. You understand that it is also the most he knows how to say.
scenes.image_prompt: a husband and wife kneeling side by side on a veranda looking at the garden, not speaking, soft afternoon light, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: The years settle into their rhythm again. Rice, sewing, accounts, snow, blossom. Your son grows tall and begins his own duties at the castle.
scenes.image_prompt: a tall young man in samurai clothing bowing to his mother at the house gate before leaving, early morning, calm pride, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Your mother-in-law grows frail. One autumn morning she does not wake. You wash her hands yourself and dress her in white.
scenes.image_prompt: an autumn room with an elderly woman lying peacefully under a white cover, a middle-aged woman kneeling beside her in quiet respect, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Now you are the elder woman of the house. Your son's young bride kneels before you, nervous, with her white silk still smelling of cedar.
scenes.image_prompt: a middle-aged woman kneeling and welcoming a nervous young bride in white, candlelit room, gentle and kind expression, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: You show her the stove, the account book, and the trick with the embers. You tell her the rice price. You tell her to breathe.
scenes.image_prompt: an older woman showing a young woman how to tend a clay stove, soft morning light through a kitchen window, warm mentoring mood, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: On your husband's last spring, you sit together on the veranda under a thin blanket and watch the persimmon tree bud.
scenes.image_prompt: an elderly samurai couple sitting together on a veranda under a thin blanket, looking at a budding persimmon tree, soft spring light, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: You never chose him, and he never chose you. And yet you cannot now imagine a life in which you were not beside him.
scenes.image_prompt: close view of two elderly hands, a man's and a woman's, resting near each other on a wooden veranda, cherry petals nearby, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: After he is gone, you keep his lantern. On winter evenings you light it and let the orange glow climb the ceiling, as it always did.
scenes.image_prompt: an elderly woman kneeling beside a glowing paper lantern in a quiet room at night, snow visible outside, peaceful solitude, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: Your grandson falls asleep against your arm, just as his father once did. Outside, snow drips from the eaves in the dark.
scenes.image_prompt: an elderly woman sitting in lamplight with a sleeping small boy against her arm, eaves dripping outside, deep calm, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: History remembers the lords, the swords, and the processions. It rarely remembers the woman who kept the house warm while they were away.
scenes.image_prompt: wide view of a snowy samurai lane at night, earthen walls wrapped in straw, a single warm glowing window, peaceful, Edo-period Japan, soft painterly style, wide 16:9 composition, muted natural colours, calm atmosphere, no text

scenes.narration: But the house remembers. The stove, the comb, the persimmon tree. And somewhere in that quiet, your breath slows, and you rest.

scenes.narration: Your husband comes home early and sits too carefully. He must march to Edo for a whole year.
Great lords spent every other year in Edo, and their samurai went with them.
At the gate, he looks at you a moment longer than custom allows.
Now you run the house. You sell stipend rice and haggle quietly and firmly.
The domain borrows part of every stipend. So you cut lamp oil, and take in sewing.
Then your son catches a fever, and for three nights you do not sleep.
What happened when he came home? The full story of her life is on the channel.

scenes.narration: Tomorrow you marry a samurai you have met exactly once, across a formal room.
Three small cups of sake, three sips each. Then you belong to his house.
As a new wife, you blacken your teeth. In this age, many find it beautiful.
Your family is paid in rice, not coins. Seventy koku a year, and most must be sold.
In winter, pines are tied with ropes like umbrellas so snow cannot break them.
Your mother-in-law hands you her own wedding comb, and says softly that she once was you.
And one day, your husband is ordered to leave for Edo. Watch the full story.

editor_notes: Critic cut a jarring childbirth-danger passage, softened death scenes, hedged the stipend-loan and travel-time facts, and moved the Edo departure earlier as the mid-video tension peak.
